numerical_certification_target: For each retained sample certify D_true >= D_saved - 0.1, with actual RN density and conditional moment bounds; no such certificate is claimed.
replay_policy: Default verifier never samples. Optional --resample runs in a new directory and must not replace the registered primary result.
registered_source_whitespace: natural_probe.py retains its original extra final blank line because its exact SHA256 was frozen before confirmation; no source normalization was performed.
